questions.question: The greatest number that divides 48 and 46 leaving remainders 9 and 7, respectively, is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Subtract the **remainders** from the given numbers: (48 − 9) and (46 − 7).

Find the **HCF** of 39 and 39.

HCF(39, 39) = 39.

**∴ The correct answer is 39.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Numbers 48 and 46; Remainders 9 and 7.

**Formula Used:** Required Number = HCF[(Number₁ − Remainder₁), (Number₂ − Remainder₂)]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93cf7c52fd1667e2f9374bed5b46dc1f2414f8539dfba73264e9e8d0ca733829.png] 

⇒ First number after removing remainder = 48 − 9 = 39

⇒ Second number after removing remainder = 46 − 7 = 39

⇒ Greatest common divisor for 39 and 39 is 39.

**∴ The correct answer is 39.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

HCF with different remainders

To find the **greatest number** that divides x, y, z leaving remainders a, b, c respectively, calculate HCF of (x−a), (y−b), and (z−c).

HCF with same remainder

If the **remainder** is the same but unknown, the greatest number is HCF of |x−y|, |y−z|, and |z−x|.

LCM Relationship

For any two numbers A and B: HCF(A, B) × LCM(A, B) = A × B.</p

questions.question: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 22?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a number to be **divisible by 22**, it must be **divisible by 2 and 11**.

Check **even numbers** only (divisible by 2): Options (2) 7986 and (3) 7664.

Check **divisibility by 11** for 7986: (7 + 8) − (9 + 6) = 15 − 15 = 0.

Since the difference is **0**, the number is divisible by 11.

**∴ The correct answer is 7986.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Numbers 7019, 7986, 7664, 8371. Check **divisibility by 22**.

**Condition:** Divisible by 2 (last digit even) AND divisible by 11 (difference of sum of digits at odd and even places is 0 or multiple of 11).

⇒ **Step 1:** Eliminate odd numbers 7019 and 8371 (not divisible by 2).

⇒ **Step 2:** Test 7986 for 11: Sum of odd positions (7+8=15), Sum of even positions (9+6=15). Difference = 15 − 15 = 0.

⇒ **Step 3:** Test 7664 for 11: Sum of odd positions (7+6=13), Sum of even positions (6+4=10). Difference = 13 − 10 = 3 (not divisible by 11).

⇒ **Conclusion:** Only 7986 satisfies both conditions.

**∴ The correct answer is 7986.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 11

A number is divisible by 11 if the **absolute difference** between the sum of digits at odd places and even places is 0 or a multiple of 11.

Divisibility of Composite Numbers

To check divisibility by a composite number like 22, check divisibility by its **co-prime factors** (2 and 11).

Divisibility by 2

Any number ending with an **even digit** (0, 2, 4, 6, 8) is divisible by 2.</p

questions.question: Three numbers are in the ratio 1 : 3 : 5, and their LCM is 285. Their HCF is ____.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the **HCF** be **x**.

Numbers = 1x, 3x, 5x

LCM of (1, 3, 5) × **HCF** = 285

15 × x = 285 ⇒ x = 19

**∴ The correct answer is 19.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/271a9f448187d860367f016ab50b90d29fc750bdeec8b5dd39de93932c95ecb5.png] 

**Given:**

Ratio of numbers = 1 : 3 : 5

**LCM** = 285

**Formula Used:**

If numbers are in ratio a : b : c, then their **LCM** = HCF × LCM(a, b, c)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the **HCF** be H.

⇒ The numbers are 1H, 3H, and 5H.

⇒ Since 1, 3, and 5 are **co-prime** to each other, their LCM is 1 × 3 × 5 = 15.

⇒ Total **LCM** = 15 × H

⇒ 15 × H = 285

⇒ H = 285 ÷ 15

⇒ H = 19

**∴ The correct answer is 19.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Product of Two Numbers

For any two numbers A and B, the product of the numbers is equal to the product of their **HCF** and **LCM**: A × B = HCF × LCM.

HCF of Fractions

**HCF** of fractions = (HCF of Numerators) ÷ (LCM of Denominators).

Co-prime Numbers

Two numbers are said to be **co-prime** if their **HCF** is 1. The **LCM** of co-prime numbers is always their product.</p

questions.question: Find the smallest number by which 6760 must be multiplied to make it a perfect square.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify the **prime factors** of 6760.

6760 = 676 × 10 = 26² × 2 × 5.

Pairs: (26 × 26) is already a **perfect square**.

Unpaired factors: 2 × 5 = 10.

To make it a **perfect square**, multiply by the **unpaired factors** (10).

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** The number is **6760**.

**Formula Used:** A number is a **perfect square** if all its **prime factors** occur in pairs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57680586a3bd22dcbb4484f4e13b295617d7709c30c403d9b8b7776df6374242.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Prime Factorization of 6760:

⇒ 6760 = 2 × 3380

⇒ 3380 = 2 × 1690

⇒ 1690 = 2 × 845

⇒ 845 = 5 × 169

⇒ 169 = 13 × 13

⇒ 6760 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 5 × 13 × 13

⇒ Grouping in pairs: (2 × 2) × (13 × 13) × 2 × 5

⇒ The **unpaired factors** are 2 and 5.

⇒ Smallest number to multiply = 2 × 5 = 10.

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Perfect Square Property

In the **prime factorization** of a perfect square, the exponent of every **prime factor** must be even.

Making a Perfect Square (Division)

To make a number a perfect square by **division**, we divide by the same **unpaired factors** (e.g., 6760 ÷ 10 = 676, which is 26²).

Unit Digits of Perfect Squares

A **perfect square** never ends in the digits 2, 3, 7, or 8.</p

questions.question: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 64?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

A number is divisible by **64** if its last **6 digits** are divisible by 64, or if it is a multiple of 8 and 16.

Check **5760**: It ends in 0 and is an even number. 5760 ÷ 64 = 90.

Odd numbers like **5327**, **5129**, and **4797** can never be divisible by an even number like 64.

**∴ The correct answer is 5760.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Numbers 5327, 5129, 5760, 4797.

**Property:** For a number to be divisible by **64** (which is 2⁶), the number must be **even**.

⇒ 5327 is **Odd** → Not divisible.

⇒ 5129 is **Odd** → Not divisible.

⇒ 4797 is **Odd** → Not divisible.

⇒ Checking 5760: 5760 ÷ 64

⇒ 5760 ÷ 8 = 720

⇒ 720 ÷ 8 = 90

⇒ Since 5760 is divisible by 8 × 8 (which is 64), it is the correct number.

**∴ The correct answer is 5760.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility by powers of 2

A number is divisible by 2ⁿ if the last **n digits** of the number are divisible by 2ⁿ. For 64 (2⁶), the last 6 digits must be divisible by 64.

Even and Odd Rule

An **even divisor** can only divide **even numbers**. If the divisor is 64, any number ending in 1, 3, 5, 7, or 9 is automatically excluded.

Divisibility by 8

A number is divisible by 8 if its last **three digits** are divisible by 8. This is a prerequisite for divisibility by 64.</p

questions.question: Which of the following is the greatest number that divides 104 and 133 and leaves 8 and 5 as respective remainders?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Subtract the **remainders** from the given numbers: 104 − 8 = **96** and 133 − 5 = **128**.

Find the **HCF** of 96 and 128.

HCF(96, 128) = **32** because 32 × 3 = 96 and 32 × 4 = 128.

**∴ The correct answer is 32.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Numbers are 104 and 133, **remainders** are 8 and 5 respectively.

**Formula Used:** Required number = **HCF**(Number₁ − Remainder₁, Number₂ − Remainder₂)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c1e0f884708704653bb7180a6ab7f640fd514bddbd37ca0b669e7f12e03321c.png] 

⇒ First number = 104 − 8 = **96**

⇒ Second number = 133 − 5 = **128**

⇒ Factors of 96: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 24, **32**, 48, 96

⇒ Factors of 128: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, **32**, 64, 128

⇒ Highest Common Factor (**HCF**) = **32**

**∴ The correct answer is 32.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

HCF Definition

The **Highest Common Factor (HCF)** is the largest positive integer that divides each of the integers without a remainder.

Remainder Rule for HCF

To find the **greatest number** that leaves remainders a and b when dividing x and y, always find **HCF(x−a, y−b)**.

Euclid Division Lemma

For any two positive integers a and b, there exist unique integers q and r such that **a = bq + r**, where 0 ≤ r < b.</p

questions.question: Find the smallest number by which 6627 must be multiplied to make it a perfect square.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Perform **Prime Factorisation** of 6627.

6627 = 3 × 13 × 13 × 13 = 3¹ × 13³.

To make it a **perfect square**, all prime factors must have **even powers**.

Required multipliers = 3¹ × 13¹ = 39. (Wait, let us re-check the division).

6627 ÷ 3 = 2209. We know 2209 = 47².

∴ 6627 = 3 × 47². The **unpaired factor** is 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Number = 6627.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52fd5e8c93a15052c0517a422078d60b3cf4199b431d1585ddc0cd30ee2105ab.png] 

**Step-by-step Calculation:**

⇒ Sum of digits of 6627 = 6 + 6 + 2 + 7 = 21 (Divisible by 3).

⇒ 6627 ÷ 3 = 2209.

⇒ 2209 is a **perfect square** since √2209 = 47.

⇒ Prime factorisation of 6627 = 3¹ × 47².

⇒ For a number to be a **perfect square**, the power of every prime factor must be **even**.

⇒ Here, 3 has a power of 1. To make it even, we must multiply by 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Perfect Square Condition

A number is a perfect square if all its prime factors appear in **pairs** (even exponents).

Smallest Multiplier/Divisor

To find the smallest number to multiply/divide to make a perfect square, identify the **unpaired factors** in the prime factorisation.

Divisibility Rule of 3

A number is divisible by 3 if the **sum of its digits** is divisible by 3.</p

questions.question: Three numbers are in the ratio 3 : 2 : 13, and their LCM is 4758. Their HCF is ______.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the **HCF** be **H**.

The numbers are 3H, 2H, and 13H.

LCM of (3, 2, 13) × H = 4758

78 × H = 4758

H = 4758 ÷ 78 = 61

**∴ The correct answer is 61.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/282a4d762b57a4844a2b0b069559ff76ba9a8b4b31c4743d9c9f8e814c42661c.png] 

**Given:**

Ratio of numbers = **3 : 2 : 13**

**LCM** of numbers = **4758**

Let the **Highest Common Factor (HCF)** be **x**.

⇒ The numbers are **3x**, **2x**, and **13x**.

⇒ Since 3, 2, and 13 are **prime numbers** relative to each other (co-prime), their LCM is their product multiplied by the HCF.

⇒ LCM = 3 × 2 × 13 × x

⇒ 4758 = 78x

⇒ x = 4758 ÷ 78

⇒ x = 61

**∴ The correct answer is 61.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM and HCF Relationship

For two numbers a and b, Product of numbers = HCF × LCM. For more than two numbers, this direct product rule does not apply simply.

Ratio and HCF

If the ratio of numbers is a:b:c and their HCF is H, the numbers are aH, bH, and cH. Their LCM is H × LCM(a, b, c).

Co-prime Numbers

If numbers are co-prime, their HCF is 1 and their LCM is simply the product of the numbers.</p

questions.question: Find the smallest number by which 4232 must be multiplied to make it a perfect square.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Perform prime factorization of **4232**.

4232 = 2 × 2116 = 2 × 2 × 1058 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 529 = 2³ × 23²

Grouping into pairs: (2 × 2) × 2 × (23 × 23).

Only one **2** is left without a pair, so we must multiply by **2**.

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given number is **4232**.

To find the smallest number to multiply to make it a **perfect square**, we use the **prime factorization method**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb4cd647d682f8729a0432f78e6dad6a983b894773079cba1267dd2dde750a8c.png] 

⇒ Prime factors of 4232 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 23 × 23

⇒ Grouping the prime factors in identical pairs: (2 × 2) × (23 × 23) × 2

⇒ The prime factor **2** does not have a pair.

⇒ Therefore, 4232 must be multiplied by **2** to make it a perfect square.

⇒ New number = 4232 × 2 = 8464 (which is 92²)

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

**__Additional Information__**

Perfect Square Property

In the prime factorization of any perfect square, the exponent of every prime factor must be an even number.

Division Rule for Perfect Squares

The smallest number by which a number must be divided to make it a perfect square is also the unpaired factor (which is 2 in this case).</p

questions.question: The least number which, when diminished by 8, is divisible by 15, 12, 18 and 29 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **least number** is the **LCM** of (15, 12, 18, 29) + **diminished value**.

LCM(15, 12, 18, 29) → LCM(60, 18, 29) → LCM(180, 29).

Required number = (180 × 29) + 8 = 5220 + 8 = 5228.

**∴ The correct answer is 5228.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Divisors = 15, 12, 18, 29; Diminished value = 8.

**Formula Used:** Required Number = LCM(Divisors) + Remainder/Diminished value.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08951313feb683cdea68db9b5e3c8f60a747aed1f26a05ed6fafdf72659a22e5.png] 

⇒ Prime factors of 15 = 3 × 5

⇒ Prime factors of 12 = 2² × 3

⇒ Prime factors of 18 = 2 × 3²

⇒ Prime factors of 29 = 29 (Prime number)

⇒ LCM = 2² × 3² × 5 × 29

⇒ LCM = 4 × 9 × 5 × 29 = 180 × 29 = 5220

⇒ Required number = 5220 + 8 = 5228

**∴ The correct answer is 5228.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM (Least Common Multiple)

The smallest positive integer that is divisible by each of the given numbers. Calculation: LCM(a, b) = (a × b) ÷ HCF(a, b).

Divisibility Rule for 9 (Special Case for 18)

If a number is divisible by 18, it must be divisible by 9. The sum of the digits of (5228 − 8) = 5+2+2+0 = 9, which is divisible by 9.

Prime Numbers

Numbers like 29 have no factors other than 1 and themselves; hence, they are multiplied directly in LCM calculations.</p

questions.question: Three numbers are in the ratio 1: 11:19, and their LCM is 8778. Their HCF is
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the **HCF** be **x**.

Numbers are **x**, **11x**, and **19x**.

LCM of (1, 11, 19) × **HCF** = **Given LCM**

Since 1, 11, and 19 are **coprime**, their LCM is 1 × 11 × 19 = 209.

209 × **x** = 8778 ⇒ **x** = 8778 ÷ 209 = 42.

**∴ The correct answer is 42.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Ratio of three numbers = 1 : 11 : 19 and **LCM** = 8778.

**Formula:** LCM of numbers = HCF × (Product of ratios if they are coprime).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3099d19a2fe39d155ecffad58819f05c8a2934ebfee17543c10eddaae0b81216.png] 

⇒ Let the numbers be 1x, 11x, and 19x where **x** is the **HCF**.

⇒ **LCM** (x, 11x, 19x) = x × **LCM** (1, 11, 19)

⇒ Since 1, 11, and 19 have no common factors, **LCM** = x × 1 × 11 × 19 = 209x.

⇒ 209x = 8778

⇒ x = 8778 ÷ 209

⇒ x = 42

**∴ The correct answer is 42.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM and HCF Relationship

For two numbers a and b, **HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b) = a × b**. This does not directly apply to three or more numbers.

Coprime Numbers

If numbers are **coprime**, their **HCF** is 1 and their **LCM** is the product of the numbers.

Ratio Property

If the ratio of numbers is a:b:c and their **HCF** is k, then the numbers are ak, bk, and ck.</p

questions.question: Ramesh purchased (4x – 3y) dolls from a shop at the rate of ₹(x + y) per doll. Find the total money paid by Ramesh to the shopkeeper.

questions.question: Which of the following is the greatest number that divides 137 and 198 and leaves 7 and 3 as respective remainders?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Subtract the **remainders** from the given numbers: (137 − 7) = 130 and (198 − 3) = 195.

Find the **HCF** of 130 and 195.

Factors of 130 = 65 × 2; Factors of 195 = 65 × 3.

The **highest common factor** is 65.

**∴ The correct answer is 65.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Numbers 137 and 198 with **remainders** 7 and 3 respectively.

**Formula Used:** Required Number = **HCF**(Number₁ − Remainder₁, Number₂ − Remainder₂)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc64578c314138418b2c6640622a063b965d035bf6655d4e509e9659b33c25d5.png] 

⇒ First number to divide: 137 − 7 = 130

⇒ Second number to divide: 198 − 3 = 195

⇒ **HCF**(130, 195):

⇒ 130 = 2 × 5 × 13

⇒ 195 = 3 × 5 × 13

⇒ Common factors = 5 × 13 = 65

**∴ The correct answer is 65.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Highest Common Factor (HCF)

Also known as **GCD (Greatest Common Divisor)**, it is the largest positive integer that divides each of the integers without leaving a remainder.

HCF with Remainders

To find the **greatest number** that divides a, b, c leaving remainders x, y, z, find HCF of (a−x), (b−y), and (c−z).

Euclid's Division Lemma

States that for any two positive integers a and b, there exist unique integers q and r such that a = bq + r, where 0 ≤ r < b.</p

questions.question: In finding the HCF of two numbers by division method, the quotients are 1, 4, and 6, respectively, and the last divisor is 29. What is the LCM of the two numbers?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Work backwards from the **last divisor**: 29.

Divisor₃ = 29, Remainder₃ = 0 ⇒ Dividend₃ = 29 × 6 + 0 = 174.

Divisor₂ = 174, Remainder₂ = 29 ⇒ Dividend₂ = 174 × 4 + 29 = 725.

Divisor₁ = 725, Remainder₁ = 174 ⇒ Dividend₁ = 725 × 1 + 174 = 899.

LCM = (Product of numbers) ÷ HCF = (899 × 725) ÷ 29 = 22475.

**∴ The correct answer is 22475.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Quotients = 1, 4, 6 | Last divisor (HCF) = 29.

**Formula:** Dividend = (Divisor × Quotient) + Remainder

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/064f201dcfbb6275929c39c096a1077e40297710b2cd5056fe0cbe2ebe31386b.png] 

⇒ Let the numbers be A and B (A > B). In the long division method, the last divisor is the HCF.

⇒ **Step 3:** Last divisor = 29, Quotient = 6. Third Dividend = 29 × 6 = 174.

⇒ **Step 2:** Divisor = 174, Quotient = 4, Remainder = 29. Second Dividend (B) = 174 × 4 + 29 = 725.

⇒ **Step 1:** Divisor = 725, Quotient = 1, Remainder = 174. First Dividend (A) = 725 × 1 + 174 = 899.

⇒ LCM(899, 725) = (899 × 725) ÷ 29

⇒ LCM = 31 × 725 = 22475.

**∴ The correct answer is 22475.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

HCF by Long Division

Also known as the **Euclidean Algorithm**, where the remainder of one step becomes the divisor for the next until the remainder is zero.

HCF and LCM Relation

For any two numbers A and B: A × B = HCF(A, B) × LCM(A, B).

Coprime Numbers

If the HCF of two numbers is 1, they are called **coprime**, and their LCM is simply their product.</p

questions.question: Keshav's salary is ₹13,000 per month. He spends ₹4,000 on house rent, ₹1,500 on bills and the rest of the amount is his monthly savings. Find his savings (in) in a year, if in the month of his birthday, he spent his complete monthly savings for the birthday celebration.

**Savings Months** = 12 − 1 (birthday month) = 11 months.

Percentage Savings

Divisor₁ = 2337 × 1 + 456 = 2793

**LCM** = (2337 × 2793) ÷ 57 = 114513.

**∴ The correct answer is 114513.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/439aad8a4efc95561159fb2d3cc2d29cd1a763176aae61bc1b6e01a1083f3aa3.png] 

**Given:** Quotients = 1, 5, 8; Last divisor (HCF) = 57.

**Formula Used:** Dividend = (Divisor × Quotient) + Remainder

⇒ **Third Dividend** = (57 × 8) + 0 = 456

⇒ **Second Dividend** = (456 × 5) + 57 = 2280 + 57 = 2337

⇒ **First Dividend** = (2337 × 1) + 456 = 2793

⇒ Two numbers are 2337 and 2793.

⇒ **LCM** = (Product of numbers) ÷ HCF

⇒ **LCM** = (2337 × 2793) ÷ 57

⇒ **LCM** = 41 × 2793 = 114513

**∴ The correct answer is 114513.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

HCF by Long Division

This method involves **successive division** where the remainder of one step becomes the divisor for the next step until the remainder is zero.

Relation between HCF and LCM

For any two numbers a and b: **a × b = HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b)**. This is used to find one value when the other three are known.

Properties of HCF

The **HCF** of two or more numbers is the greatest number that divides each of them exactly without leaving a remainder.</p

questions.question: Amit's salary is ₹13,000 per month. He spends ₹4,000 on house rent, ₹2,000 on bills, and the rest of the amount is his monthly savings. Find his savings (in ₹) in a year, if in the month of birthday he spent his complete monthly savings for a birthday celebration.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Monthly Savings** = 13,000 − (4,000 + 2,000) = ₹7,000

Total months in a year = 12

Birthday month savings spent = 0

**Annual Savings** = 7,000 × (12 − 1) = 7,000 × 11 = ₹77,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹77,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Monthly Salary = ₹13,000; Rent = ₹4,000; Bills = ₹2,000

**Formula:** Savings = Income − Expenditure

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b56363347b760d728340ba054b814e73a855a88d3d9f48ae7ae559d4109cb583.png] 

⇒ Total **Monthly Expenditure** = 4,000 + 2,000 = ₹6,000

⇒ **Monthly Savings** = 13,000 − 6,000 = ₹7,000

⇒ Total **Annual Savings** (excluding 1 month) = Monthly Savings × 11

⇒ **Annual Savings** = 7,000 × 11 = ₹77,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹77,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Savings

It is calculated as (Total Savings ÷ Total Income) × 100. This helps in understanding the **savings rate** of an individual.

Successive Changes

If income increases by x% and expenditure increases by y%, the new savings are calculated using the **base change** method.

Average Monthly Savings

It is the **total annual savings** divided by 12, regardless of variations in individual months.

questions.question: If 674 bananas were distributed among three monkeys in the ratio (17)/(2) : (14)/(6) : (2)/(5) respectively, how many bananas did the third monkey get?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Simplify ratio: 17/2 : 14/6 : 2/5 → 17/2 : 7/3 : 2/5.

LCM of denominators (2, 3, 5) = 30.

New Ratio: (17/2 × 30) : (7/3 × 30) : (2/5 × 30) = 255 : 70 : 12.

Total parts = 255 + 70 + 12 = 337 units.

337 units = 674 ⇒ 1 unit = 2 bananas.

Third monkey (12 units) = 12 × 2 = 24 bananas.

**∴ The correct answer is 24.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30ed018d4cc23ca3c667bd3069713aee376da66a56521e6008fcc3ecf63bbd8a.png] 

**Given:**

Total bananas = 674

Ratio = 17/2 : 14/6 : 2/5

**Calculations:**

⇒ First, simplify the fraction ratio by multiplying with the **LCM** of denominators 2, 6, and 5.

⇒ LCM(2, 6, 5) = 30.

⇒ Monkey 1 = (17/2) × 30 = 255

⇒ Monkey 2 = (14/6) × 30 = 70

⇒ Monkey 3 = (2/5) × 30 = 12

⇒ Total Ratio Sum = 255 + 70 + 12 = 337

⇒ Share of third monkey = (12 ÷ 337) × 674

⇒ Share = 12 × 2 = 24

**∴ The correct answer is 24.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Simplification

To convert a fractional ratio a/b : c/d into a whole number ratio, multiply each term by the **LCM** of the denominators b and d.

Proportional Division

If a total quantity X is divided in the ratio a : b : c, then the share of the third part is calculated as [c ÷ (a + b + c)] × X.

Compound Ratio

The compound ratio of (a : b) and (c : d) is found by multiplying corresponding terms, resulting in (ac : bd).</p

questions.question: Nandan had some marbles. When he distributed the marbles equally among 32 children, he found that 4 marbles were left. Had he distributed the marbles equally among 41 children and 48 children, he still would have had 13 and 20 marbles, respectively, left with him. But when he distributed them equally among 53 children, no marble was left. The number of marbles that Nandan initially had may lie between __________.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__
Check the common difference between **divisors** and **remainders**.

32 − 4 = 28, 41 − 13 = 28, 48 − 20 = 28.

Number = LCM(32, 41, 48) × k − 28, and it must be divisible by 53.

LCM(32, 41, 48) = 7872. For k = 1, Number = 7872 − 28 = 7844.

7844 ÷ 53 = 148 (Remainder 0). So, 7844 is the number.

**∴ The correct answer is 7834 and 7854.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8aae85ef718862e22a50564a627c80d4869327bb1ec4d8991b806deb4aa5cf6f.png] 
**Given:** Divisors (d₁, d₂, d₃) = 32, 41, 48 | Remainders (r₁, r₂, r₃) = 4, 13, 20.

⇒ Common difference (d − r) = 32 − 4 = 28; 41 − 13 = 28; 48 − 20 = 28.

⇒ LCM(32, 41, 48) = 2⁵ × 41 × 3 = 32 × 123 = 7872.

⇒ General form: N = 7872k − 28.

⇒ Condition: N must be exactly divisible by 53.

⇒ Test k = 1: N = 7872(1) − 28 = 7844.

⇒ Verification: 7844 = 53 × 148 + 0. (Condition satisfied).

⇒ 7844 lies between 7834 and 7854.

**∴ The correct answer is 7834 and 7854.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM with Common Difference

When (Divisor − Remainder) is constant (say x), the number is LCM(Divisors) × k − x.

LCM with Same Remainder

If every divisor leaves the same remainder r, the number is LCM(Divisors) × k + r.

Divisibility Rule of 53

To check if a number is divisible by 53, add 16 times the last digit to the rest of the number.</p

questions.question: If 56% of a number is equal to (5)/(9)​ of another number, then what is the ratio of the first number to the second number?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the **first number** be A and the **second number** be B.

Given: 56% of A = 5/9 of B

⇒ 56/100 × A = 5/9 × B

⇒ 14/25 × A = 5/9 × B

⇒ A/B = (5 × 25) / (9 × 14) = 125/126

**∴ The correct answer is 125 : 126.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6672bdfc58cf10ccd5225b4a239dd4d4be0c4358df81f7925541d01f19d3c342.png] 

**Given:**

Percentage of **First Number** (x) = 56%

Fraction of **Second Number** (y) = 5/9

**Calculations:**

⇒ 56% × x = (5/9) × y

⇒ (56/100) × x = (5/9) × y

⇒ (14/25) × x = (5/9) × y

⇒ x/y = (5/9) ÷ (14/25)

⇒ x/y = (5/9) × (25/14)

⇒ x/y = 125/126

**∴ The correct answer is 125 : 126.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

To convert a percentage to a fraction, divide the number by 100 and simplify. Example: 56% = 56/100 = 14/25.

Ratio of Equality

If m × A = n × B, then the ratio A : B is equal to n : m. This is the inverse relationship between coefficients and ratios.

Simplifying Complex Ratios

When dealing with fractions in ratios, multiply both parts by the LCM of denominators to convert to whole numbers.</p

questions.question: Which of the following is the greatest number that divides 59 and 133 and leaves 5 and 7 as respective remainders?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Subtract the **remainders** from the given numbers: (59 − 5) = 54 and (133 − 7) = 126.

Find the **HCF** of 54 and 126.

HCF(54, 126) = 18.

**∴ The correct answer is 18.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2e54a19951bbc6c9d4d979d9c918e0d2b1e0122454a78316a1393dc26101a17.png] 

**Given:**

First number = 59, Remainder₁ = 5

Second number = 133, Remainder₂ = 7

**Calculations:**

⇒ First Required Number = 59 − 5 = 54

⇒ Second Required Number = 133 − 7 = 126

⇒ Prime factors of 54 = 2 × 3 × 3 × 3 = 2 × 3³

⇒ Prime factors of 126 = 2 × 3 × 3 × 7 = 2 × 3² × 7

⇒ HCF = 2 × 3² = 2 × 9 = 18

**∴ The correct answer is 18.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

HCF with remainders

To find the greatest number dividing a, b, c leaving remainders x, y, z, calculate HCF of (a−x), (b−y), and (c−z).

LCM with remainders

To find the least number which when divided by x, y, z leaves the same remainder r, calculate [LCM(x, y, z) + r].

Product Rule

For any two numbers, Product of numbers = HCF × LCM.</p
